newsitem.title: UK: BAe up on reports of government purchase.
newsitem.headline: BAe up on reports of government purchase.

text.p: Shares in British Aerospace Plc Plc advanced on Friday after the government signalled that it could buy 40 to 50 heavy military transport aircraft from the European Airbus consortium, dealers said.
By 0852 GMT, Bae shares were up 27p, or about two percent, to 1360-1/2.
Defence secretary George Robertson on Thursday said Britain was rejoining a pan-European project to build a new military transport plane, the Future Large Aircraft.
BAe is expected to build the wings for the aircraft and Rolls-Royce Plc is likely to provide the engines.
Rolls-Royce shares were off 1/2p to 234 in thin trading.
One market-maker characterised the rally in BAe shares as an overreaction.
"The stock tends to overreact," he said. "I think Rolls-Royce (stock) is reacting more rationally."
